title: Metric over time
description: Values of one metric per group across runs, the run's start_utc as time.

list.name: section
list.label: Section
list.description: Stage / metric prefix (cpu, disk, mem, net, pg, web, ...).
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT section FROM v_values ORDER BY section
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT section FROM v_values ORDER BY section

list.name: grp
list.label: Group
list.description: Effective group: the run's `group` tag, else the automatic group.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT grp FROM v_runs ORDER BY grp
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT grp FROM v_runs ORDER BY grp

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.description: Metric id from the vmbench catalog (name and unit from benchlens' metric table).
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT id AS __value, id || '  ·  ' || name || ' [' || unit || ']' AS __text FROM v_values WHERE section IN (${section:sqlstring}) AND grp IN (${grp:sqlstring}) ORDER BY id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT id AS __value, id || '  ·  ' || name || ' [' || unit || ']' AS __text FROM v_values WHERE section IN (${section:sqlstring}) AND grp IN (${grp:sqlstring}) ORDER BY id

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run_id AS __value, label || '  ' || substr(start_utc, 1, 16) AS __text FROM v_runs WHERE grp IN (${grp:sqlstring}) ORDER BY start_utc
list.definition: SELECT run_id AS __value, label || '  ' || substr(start_utc, 1, 16) AS __text FROM v_runs WHERE grp IN (${grp:sqlstring}) ORDER BY start_utc

list.name: benchlens_url
list.label: benchlens UI
list.description: Where the benchlens web UI is reachable from your browser (for the links).

options.content: **Verdicts live in benchlens, not here.** These panels show raw values, means and ranges straight from the benchlens database (SQLite has no median). Whether a difference is *better*, *worse* or *within noise* (medians, CV and vmbench's noise rule) is decided by benchlens only: [open this metric in benchlens](${benchlens_url}/?view=metric&metric=${metric}). Each point is one run: the mean of its rounds (`v_stats.mean`).

panels.title: ${metric:text} · mean per run
panels.description: Mean of the run's rounds (v_stats), not the median benchlens compares. Runs without start_utc are left out. Time range filters on start_utc.

targets.queryText:
-- mean of one metric per run (rounds that count, see v_values), one series per group, at the run's start
SELECT r.start_utc AS time, s.grp AS grp, s.mean AS value
FROM v_stats s
JOIN v_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id
WHERE s.id = '${metric}'
  AND s.grp IN (${grp:sqlstring})
  AND s.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})
  AND r.start_utc <> ''
  AND CAST(strftime('%s', r.start_utc) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText:

SELECT r.start_utc AS time, s.grp AS grp, s.mean AS value
FROM v_stats s
JOIN v_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id
WHERE s.id = '${metric}'
  AND s.grp IN (${grp:sqlstring})
  AND s.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})
  AND r.start_utc <> ''
  AND CAST(strftime('%s', r.start_utc) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN ${__from:date:seconds} AND ${__to:date:seconds}
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Runs · ${metric:text}
panels.description: n = rounds that count (failed and excluded stages are left out). mean / min / max over those rounds.

targets.queryText:
SELECT replace(substr(r.start_utc, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS start, s.grp AS "group", s.label AS run, r.vmbench_version AS vmbench,
       s.n, s.mean, s.min, s.max, s.unit, s.direction, s.run_id
FROM v_stats s
JOIN v_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id
WHERE s.id = '${metric}'
  AND s.grp IN (${grp:sqlstring})
  AND s.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})
ORDER BY r.start_utc

  AND s.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})
ORDER BY r.start_utc
